Description
Situated just 4KM outside Limerick City, the University of Limerick (UL) is a parkland campus spanning 130 hectares on a magnificent riverside location with the River Shannon as a unifying focal point. It is located near many local amenities offering students a wide range of shops and restaurants on and off the campus. The University is ranked #501 - #511 in the world rankings by QS and is the only Irish university to receive 5 Stars. Top ranked courses include Arts, Sciences, Law, and Engineering.
